## Implements TextWriter

`ByteCursor` conforms to `TextWriter`.

<h3 id="write"><code>Write</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Write(self: &var ByteCursor, bytes: char8[..]) -> ! FormatError
```

Writes `bytes` into the buffer.
Reports `InsufficientCapacity` when the bytes do not all fit. The cursor is a bounded destination, so this
is the failure it exists to report; a `WriterFailure` is impossible, since there is no destination beyond
the buffer, and the bytes are not revalidated here, so no `TextFailure` arises either.
Unlike a builder, a cursor that overruns keeps whatever fitted rather than leaving itself unchanged: the
buffer is the caller's, the partial content is visible through [`Written`](/docs/api/format/byte-cursor#written), and [`Overran`](/docs/api/format/byte-cursor#overran) says it is partial.

| Name    | Type        | Description            |
| ------- | ----------- | ---------------------- |
| `bytes` | `char8[..]` | the UTF-8 run to write |

**Returns**: success when every byte fitted

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Format/Src/Cursor.rux#L82)
